TITLE: Apple Calendar
DESC: Apple Calendar CLI for AI agents: list, search and (policy-gated) create/update events via EventKit.
INJECTION: Static JXA script (`go:embed`). Input travels only as one JSON argv element to `/usr/bin/osascript` (absolute path), and fuzz tests check the script is never altered by input. Search text reaches EventKit only as an `NSPredicate` argument, never as format text. An integration test round-trips hostile strings through real osascript.
SECRETS: No credentials involved; macOS TCC controls access.
ONELINER: Read and manage Apple Calendar events from the command line, built for AI coding agents.
PERMISSION_HINT: macOS has not granted full Calendars access to the app that runs the CLI
INTEGRATION_NOTE: The Calendar tests create a calendar named `agent-cli-test-<random>` and delete it at the end.
FIRST_RUN: On the first run macOS asks whether your terminal app may access your calendars; choose full access.
NETWORK_SECTION: `apple-calendar` makes no network connections. Events stay in EventKit on your Mac, and your calendar accounts sync them as usual.
